uplink.description: both external pulse-counter ports reporting, alongside port 1's analog input and probe temperature
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds Elsys TLV frame exercising the external pulse counter on BOTH ports with distinct values. Raw decode confirmed via the ORACLE method against reference/upstream-codec.js: {temperature:21.5, humidity:55, vdd:3600, analog1:1500, pulse1:7, pulseAbs:123456, externalTemperature:12.5, digital:1, pulse2:9}. expected.data is the authored normalization: every port-1 external reading (analog1, pulse1, pulseAbs, externalTemperature) is scoped into channels entry `port0` under port-index-free names, and pulse2 (Elsys port 2) into `port1` as pulseRelative. Only the relative pulse counter is decoded at both positions here, so `port1` carries just that one key -- no absent-port keys are fabricated. EXT_DIGITAL (0x0d) is this unit's own reed/door switch, so `digital` and action.contactState stay top-level, as do battery and air.*.
